title: Directed differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells into intermediate mesoderm
protocol: Partially thaw the frozen vial of mitotically inactivated SNL feeder cells in 37°C water bath.
Resuspend the 1 ml cell solution in 10 ml DMEM/10% FBS medium and spin down at approximately 160 g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 10 ml DMEM/10% FBS medium.
Plate the cell suspension onto gelatin-coated plates at a density of approximately 50,000 cells/cm² and incubate overnight.
Remove differentiated hPSCs using aseptic technique.
Aspirate old hPSC medium from plate and wash with 5 ml PBS (-).
Add warm CTK dissociation solution (1 ml/10 cm plate) to the plate.
Incubate at 37°C for 3 min.
Wash out SNLs twice with 5 ml PBS (-).
Harvest the hPSC colonies in 5 ml fresh hPSC medium by using a cell scraper.
Pipette and triturate the hPSC colonies in hPSC medium using P1000 pipetman and split onto new feeder cells at a ratio between 1:3 and 1:6.
Add 5 ml hPSC medium to the hPSCs and scrape them off the surface with a cell scraper.
Pipette the cells up and down 5-10 times using a P1000 pipetman.
Plate the suspension onto gelatin-coated plates and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min to remove SNLs.
Transfer the hPSC cell solution to a 15 ml tube and allow cells to settle via gravity.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cells with 10 ml Stage 1 medium, then allow cells to settle via gravity.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cells with 8 ml Stage 1 medium containing 100 ng/ml recombinant human/mouse/rat activin A and 100 ng/ml recombinant mouse Wnt3a or 3 μM CHIR99021.
Distribute the cell suspension into a low attachment 6-well plate (2 ml/well) to form EBs. Culture at 37 °C for 2 days.
Transfer the EB solution to a 15 ml tube and allow EBs to settle via gravity.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cells with 10 ml Stage 2 medium, then allow cells to settle via gravity.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cells with 8 ml Stage 2 medium containing 100 ng/ml recombinant human BMP7 and 100 ng/ml recombinant mouse Wnt3a or 3 μM CHIR99021.
Transfer the cell solution onto a gelatin-coated 6-well plate (2 ml/well).
Change the medium containing BMP7 and Wnt3a or CHIR99021 every 2-3 days and culture at 37 °C for 4-20 days.
Repeat steps 10 – 14 to induce IM cells by colony formation.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend with 12 ml SNL-conditioned hPSC medium containing 10 ng/ml recombinant human bFGF and seed on Matrigel-coated 24-well plate (500 μl/well).
Grow the cells until hPSC colonies reach approximately 70% confluency.
Aspirate the medium and wash twice with PBS (-).
Add Stage 1 medium containing 100 ng/ml recombinant human/mouse/rat activin A and 100 ng/ml recombinant mouse Wnt3a or 3 μM CHIR99021 (500 μl/well) and culture at 37 °C for 2 days.
Aspirate the medium and wash with Stage 2 medium.
Add Stage 2 medium containing 100 ng/ml recombinant human BMP7 and 100 ng/ml recombinant mouse Wnt3a or 3 μM CHIR99021 (500 μl/well).
Change medium with BMP7 and Wnt3a or CHIR99021 every 2 - 3 days and culture for 8 days.
Repeat steps 4 – 7.
Add 2 ml warm Accutase.
Incubate at 37 °C for 6 min.
Pipet and dissociate the hPSC colonies into single cells using P1000 pipetman.
Add 8 ml Stage 1 medium and pipet the cells up and down using P1000 pipetman.
Count the cell number.
Transfer the hPSC cell solution to 15ml tube and spin down at 160 g for 5 min.

Remove the supernatant and resuspend with Stage 1 medium containing 100 ng/ml recombinant human/mouse/rat activin A, 100 ng/ml recombinant mouse Wnt3a or 3 μM CHIR99021, and 10 μM Y27,632 at a density of 6.0 X 10^5 cells/ml.
Distribute cells into Human Collagen Type I-coated 24-well plates at a density of 1.5 X 10^5 cells/cm² (500 μl/well).
Culture the cells at 37 °C for 2 days.
Aspirate the medium from the wells.
Wash the wells with warm Stage 2 medium.
Add Stage 2 medium containing 100 ng/ml recombinant human BMP7 and 100 ng/ml recombinant mouse Wnt3a or 3 μM CHIR99021 (500 μl/well).
Change the medium containing BMP7 and Wnt3a or CHIR99021 every 2 - 3 days.
Culture the cells at 37 °C for 8 days.
